data.title: Fix SLICOT translation review regressions
data.body:
## Scope
- Fix the two P1 translation issues found in AB13HD and MB04HD.
- Add focused persistent regression tests that would fail on the reviewed bugs.

## Non-goals
- Do not broaden into a full retranslation of AB13HD or MB04HD.
- Do not change unrelated SLICOT routines or wrapper ownership patterns.

## Constraints
- Compare edits against SLICOT-Reference at pinned commit a6abd01f0a72f888e482ee6c1da208838d42b0dc.
- Use persistent tests under tests/python/ or existing C-level test conventions, not throwaway snippets.
- Run targeted tests for changed routines before marking tasks complete.

data.title: Fix AB13HD C row access in Hamiltonian pencil construction
data.body:
## Goal
- Correct the AB13HD translation where Fortran C(I,1) with increment LDC was translated as a column walk.
- Remove stale self-review comments that currently describe the bug.

## Context
- Finding: src/AB/ab13hd.c around line 1842.
- Fortran reference: SLICOT-Reference/src/AB13HD.f uses CALL DAXPY( N, -ONE, C( I, 1 ), LDC, ... ), which walks row I across columns in column-major storage.

## Acceptance Criteria
- C translation uses &c[i] with increment ldc for row access, or equivalent explicit row-copy logic.
- No misleading TODO-style comments remain around this block.
- Existing AB13HD behavior remains green.

## Validation Gates
- .venv/bin/pytest tests/python/test_ab13hd.py -q

data.title: Normalize MB04HD logical workspace to bool
data.body:
## Goal
- Remove the i32-to-bool workspace mismatch in MB04HD and its callers.
- Keep MB04HD consistent with MB04CD and MB03KD logical workspace expectations.

## Context
- Finding: src/MB/mb04hd.c casts i32 *bwork to bool * before calling mb03kd.
- Fortran BWORK is LOGICAL; the C MB03KD signature expects const bool *select.

## Acceptance Criteria
- MB04HD public prototype, implementation, Python wrapper allocation, and internal callers use bool * for bwork where applicable.
- No cast from i32 * to bool * remains in the MB04HD path.
- Existing MB04HD callers compile without incompatible-pointer warnings.

## Validation Gates
- uv pip install .
- .venv/bin/pytest tests/python/test_mb04hd.py -q

data.title: Add regression coverage for the reviewed translation bugs
data.body:
## Goal
- Add focused tests that protect against recurrence of both reviewed bugs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AB13HD test exercises a non-square/row-sensitive C layout or asymmetric C data so row-vs-column access is observable.
- MB04HD test exercises a reorder path with M > 1 so the second and later BWORK entries matter.
- Tests are persistent, deterministic, and live with the relevant Python test files unless a C-level test is clearly more appropriate.

## Validation Gates
- .venv/bin/pytest tests/python/test_ab13hd.py tests/python/test_mb04hd.py -q
- .venv/bin/pytest tests/python/test_ab13hd.py tests/python/test_mb04hd.py tests/python/test_mb04cd.py tests/python/test_mb03bd.py -q

data.title: Harden translation coverage for complex SLICOT routines
data.body:
## Scope
- Add practical safeguards so translated C branches in complex SLICOT routines are not missed by green Python tests.
- Focus on branch/line visibility, differential checks against the pinned Fortran reference, and lightweight static checks for known translation hazards.

## Non-goals
- Do not require full coverage for all 600+ routines in the first pass.
- Do not replace numerical/property tests; augment them with coverage and reference comparison.
- Do not create standalone planning markdown. Keep execution details in ergo tasks and project scripts/tests.

## Key decisions
- Start with the top-complexity/high-risk routines reviewed in this session.
- Prefer deterministic small cases that force specific branches over broad random fuzzing as the first milestone.
- Treat line coverage as a gating signal for reviewed bug branches, not as a blanket percentage target initially.

data.title: spike: prove the simplest C coverage workflow for the extension
data.body:
## Goal
- Identify the lowest-friction way to build ctrlsys with C line/branch coverage locally.
- Produce exact commands future agents can run without guessing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Determine whether clang/LLVM coverage, gcov/lcov, or meson-native coverage is the best fit for this repo.
- Demonstrate coverage on at least one translated source file, preferably src/AB/ab13hd.c.
- Record the command sequence in the task completion note, not a new markdown file.

## Validation Gates
- uv pip install . succeeds with the chosen coverage build path, or the spike documents the blocker.
- A coverage report can identify whether a specific C line was executed.

data.title: Add coverage gate for reviewed translation branches
data.body:
## Goal
- Add a persistent, runnable coverage check for branches involved in reviewed translation bugs.

## Context
- AB13HD line around src/AB/ab13hd.c:1842 passed existing tests because the branch was not covered.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A script or test command fails or reports clearly when target source lines/regions are not executed.
- Initial targets include the AB13HD row-access branch and MB04HD reorder/BWORK path.
- The check is repo-local and repeatable; no throwaway snippets.

## Validation Gates
- Run the new coverage command and confirm it reports target coverage.
- .venv/bin/pytest tests/python/test_ab13hd.py tests/python/test_mb04hd.py -q

data.title: Add Fortran differential tests for top-risk routines
data.body:
## Goal
- Compare selected C outputs against the pinned SLICOT-Reference implementation for high-risk translated routines.

## Context
- The submodule is pinned at a6abd01f0a72f888e482ee6c1da208838d42b0dc.
- Differential tests should prioritize small deterministic cases that force fragile translation branches.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Establish a reusable test helper or script for invoking the Fortran reference for at least AB13HD or another high-risk routine.
- Include one deterministic case that would expose row-vs-column C access if regressed.
- Tests skip with a clear reason if the Fortran reference toolchain is unavailable, rather than failing opaquely.

## Validation Gates
- .venv/bin/pytest tests/python/test_ab13hd.py -q
- The new differential test command either passes or skips explicitly when gfortran/reference build is missing.

data.title: Add static translation-smell checks for BLAS strides and logical casts
data.body:
## Goal
- Catch repeatable translation mistakes before runtime tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add a repo-local check that flags suspicious patterns such as row walks translated as contiguous column walks and casts like (bool *) from non-bool logical workspaces.
- Initial check covers the AB13HD C-row/DAXPY pattern and MB04HD bool-cast pattern.
- False positives are either avoided or documented inline in the check with narrow allowlists.

## Validation Gates
- Run the new check and confirm it fails on a seeded bad pattern or detects the current known pattern before the fix.
- Run the check after fixes and confirm it passes.

data.title: Document coverage expectations in existing contributor instructions
data.body:
## Goal
- Make the new coverage/differential/static checks discoverable for future translation reviews without adding a separate planning document.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Update an existing repo instruction or developer doc with concise commands and when to run them.
- Include the rule of thumb: green Python tests are not enough for complex translated branches; prove target branch coverage or compare to Fortran.

## Validation Gates
- Commands in the doc/instruction update are copy-paste runnable.
- No new standalone planning markdown is introduced.

## Goal
- Identify the lowest-friction way to build ctrlsys with C line/branch coverage locally.
- Produce exact commands future agents can run without guessing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Determine whether clang/LLVM coverage, gcov/lcov, or meson-native coverage is the best fit for this repo.
- Demonstrate coverage on at least one translated source file, preferably src/AB/ab13hd.c.
- Record the command sequence in the task completion note, not a new markdown file.

## Validation Gates
- uv pip install . succeeds with the chosen coverage build path, or the spike documents the blocker.
- A coverage report can identify whether a specific C line was executed.

## Completion Note
Chosen path: clang gcov-style coverage through a persistent meson-python editable build. LLVM source-based coverage (`-fprofile-instr-generate -fcoverage-mapping`) produced coverage metadata in `_slicot`, but did not flush `.profraw` files when loaded as a Python extension on Darwin, even with `-Wl,-u,___llvm_profile_runtime`. The reliable local workflow is `--coverage` plus `xcrun llvm-cov gcov`.

Working command sequence:

```bash
rm -rf .venv-gcov
find build -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'cp313*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
uv venv .venv-gcov
uv pip install --python .venv-gcov/bin/python pip 'numpy>=2.0' meson-python 'meson>=1.1.0' ninja 'pytest>=7.0.0' 'pytest-xdist>=3.0.0' 'pytest-rerunfailures>=14.0'
env PATH="$PWD/.venv-gcov/bin:$PATH" CC=clang CFLAGS='-O0 -g --coverage' LDFLAGS='--coverage' \
  .venv-gcov/bin/python -m pip install --no-build-isolation -e .
find build/cp313 -name '*.gcda' -delete
env PATH="$PWD/.venv-gcov/bin:$PATH" .venv-gcov/bin/python -m pytest tests/python/test_ab13hd.py -q --override-ini addopts=
(cd build/cp313 && xcrun llvm-cov gcov src/libslicot.a.p/AB_ab13hd.c.gcno)
rg -n '1837|1842|case0|DAXPY|c\\[i' build/cp313/ab13hd.c.gcov
```

Validation result: `tests/python/test_ab13hd.py` passed (`15 passed in 2.27s`), generated `build/cp313/src/libslicot.a.p/AB_ab13hd.c.gcda`, and `xcrun llvm-cov gcov` reported `Lines executed:54.75% of 1812` for `src/AB/ab13hd.c`. The generated `build/cp313/ab13hd.c.gcov` clearly showed the bad `SLC_DAXPY` line at C source line 1842 as `#####`, proving the current AB13HD tests do not execute that statement.

## Goal
- Add a persistent, runnable coverage check for branches involved in reviewed translation bugs.

## Context
- AB13HD line around src/AB/ab13hd.c:1842 passed existing tests because the branch was not covered.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A script or test command fails or reports clearly when target source lines/regions are not executed.
- Initial targets include the AB13HD row-access branch and MB04HD reorder/BWORK path.
- The check is repo-local and repeatable; no throwaway snippets.

## Validation Gates
- Run the new coverage command and confirm it reports target coverage.
- .venv/bin/pytest tests/python/test_ab13hd.py tests/python/test_mb04hd.py -q

## Completion Note
Added `scripts/check_translation_coverage.py`, a repo-local targeted C line coverage gate. It builds a persistent meson-python editable coverage environment in `.venv-gcov` using `clang --coverage`, runs the AB13HD/MB04HD Python tests serially, generates gcov data with `xcrun llvm-cov gcov`, and reports configured source lines.

Default targets:
- `src/AB/ab13hd.c:1842` (`AB13HD C-row access branch`)
- `src/MB/mb04hd.c:228` (`MB04HD reorder/BWORK call`)

Validation:
- `scripts/check_translation_coverage.py --report-only` passed as a reporting command and showed `src/AB/ab13hd.c:1842` as `UNCOVERED count=0`, while `src/MB/mb04hd.c:228` was `covered count=5`.
- `scripts/check_translation_coverage.py --no-build` exited with status 1 and the same clear uncovered AB13HD report, confirming it behaves as a gate.
- `.venv/bin/pytest tests/python/test_ab13hd.py tests/python/test_mb04hd.py -q --override-ini addopts=` passed (`24 passed in 0.22s`).

## Goal
- Catch repeatable translation mistakes before runtime tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add a repo-local check that flags suspicious patterns such as row walks translated as contiguous column walks and casts like (bool *) from non-bool logical workspaces.
- Initial check covers the AB13HD C-row/DAXPY pattern and MB04HD bool-cast pattern.
- False positives are either avoided or documented inline in the check with narrow allowlists.

## Validation Gates
- Run the new check and confirm it fails on a seeded bad pattern or detects the current known pattern before the fix.
- Run the check after fixes and confirm it passes.

## Progress Note
Added `scripts/check_translation_smells.py` with narrow rules for the current reviewed hazards instead of a broad BLAS-stride heuristic. A broad DAXPY regex produces many legitimate column-walk hits in this repository, so the initial rules are intentionally exact and should be expanded only as translation patterns are confirmed.

Validation completed:
- `python3 -m py_compile scripts/check_translation_smells.py` passed.
- `scripts/check_translation_smells.py` exited with status 1 and detected the current known patterns before fixes:
  - `src/AB/ab13hd.c:1842` contiguous `&c[i * ldc]` / increment-1 DAXPY row-walk hazard.
  - `src/AB/ab13hd.c:1925` another contiguous `&c[i * ldc]` / increment-1 DAXPY row-walk hazard.
  - `src/MB/mb04hd.c:228` `(bool *)bwork` cast hazard.

Blocked on the final validation gate: this check cannot pass until the underlying AB13HD/MB04HD review fixes are applied.
